page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external storage options and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 945.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1108.19, both falling into the bottom 25% tier. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 8272.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 23181.17. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle tier, achieving 98.48 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 49.01 GB/sec for large block write operations.

This hardware profile is suited for workloads that benefit from parallel processing but do not require high single-threaded performance. Appropriate applications include static web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and moderate database operations, which are supported by a Redis SET performance of 22.12 million operations per second. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration makes it less suitable for intensive data science or large-scale machine learning tasks, though it can handle small to medium language model inference at moderate speeds.

Memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average tier, making this instance suitable for multi-threaded workloads, static web serving, and moderate database tasks that do not demand high single-threaded speed or local NVMe storage.
